title: Album Colors
text:
This page calculates the average Red, Green, and Blue (RGB) color values for each Taylor Swift album cover.

library(tidyverse)
library(jpeg)

# Helper function to get average R, G, and B values (0 to 1)
get_avg_rgb <- \(file) {
  img <- readJPEG(file)
  if (length(dim(img)) == 2) {
    val <- mean(img)
    tibble(r = val, g = val, b = val)
  } else {
    means <- apply(img, 3, mean)
    tibble(r = means[1], g = means[2], b = means[3])
  }
}

# Read images and compute average colors
album_colors <- tibble(file = list.files("data/swift", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.jpg$")) |>
  mutate(
    album = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)),
    avg = map(file, get_avg_rgb)
  ) |>
  unnest(avg) |>
  select(album, r, g, b)
